evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: "Structured and analytical manner with emphasis on data quality" is listed as a required qualification. Sustainability compliance context (EUDR) reinforces accuracy over speed throughout.
evidence.domain_risk: "EUDR compliance systems (e.g., osapiens)" and "Geodata validation tools experience" are listed; EUDR is a hard regulatory deadline with legal liability implications.
evidence.jd_authorship: Phrases are generic and high-level: "Improve data management processes and contribute innovative ideas", "Proactive, self-motivated, solution-oriented approach". No scale numbers, no infrastructure specifics beyond tool names.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: "Develop and implement a unified sustainability data platform integrating multiple sources" and "Design and operate scalable data pipelines within Microsoft Fabric" signal a build-from-scratch effort.
evidence.data_team_maturity: No mention of team composition or reporting structure. "Contribute innovative ideas to the team" suggests a small, collaborative unit where individual contribution is visible.
evidence.collaboration_width: "Cross-functional collaboration abilities" is listed generically with no named functions or departments. "Gather requirements and translate them into effective reporting and analytics solutions" implies some stakeholder interaction.
evidence.language_gate: "German, Spanish, or Portuguese language skills" listed under Preferred/Bonus Skills. "English fluency" is listed under Required Qualifications.
